title: Avomi PRO Prefilled Pods - Strawberry Ice
description: Strawberry Ice is a perfectly balanced fruit-and-ice profile, pairing the sweet, sun-ripened juiciness of fresh Strawberries with a crisp and revitalising Menthol exhale that keeps the palate feeling fresh. Each pack contains two 2ml prefilled pods, providing a combined total of 4ml of e-liquid and up to 2000 puffs per pack. Filled with a premium 20mg nicotine salt formula, these pods deliver a smooth throat hit and rapid absorption for instant satisfaction. Designed exclusively for the Avomi Pro Prefilled Starter Kit, these pods utilise advanced mesh coil technology to ensure rapid, even heating. This guarantees pristine flavour reproduction and a highly consistent Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw from the first inhale to the last. When a pod is empty, simply swap it out for a fresh one to keep your device running at peak performance.
